bundle.shortDescription: Hyperliquid trading panel with a multi-chart workspace
bundle.longDescription: TradePanel is a desktop trading panel for Hyperliquid with a synchronized multi-chart analysis workspace covering eight public crypto exchanges. Trading logic runs in a supervised Python sidecar; the desktop shell is Tauri 2.
